name: Astecnos America Corporation
old_description: As of April 1, 2016, we changed our corporate name and will strengthen its brand management .
about:
Astecnos America Corporation is headquartered in Nicholasville, Kentucky. The company adopted its current name on April 1, 2016, changing from ASTEC to strengthen brand management, according to a news release on its website. The founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in the available sources.

The company's website references an "FA Consulting System," production facilities and network, and R&D achievements, indicating a focus on factory automation consulting and engineering services. Specific manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, production volumes, and part numbers are not provided in the input.

Industries served and customer types are not specified in the available materials.

The stated reason for the 2016 name change was to strengthen brand management. No further differentiation claims or founding mission are documented in the input.
